what_happened: In job 4scc, a retry of the landing-records change, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work went on. The previous attempt's code passed every check. Only acceptance criterion 7 failed, which concerns the change description. The user said the commit message body and the CHANGELOG entry must list every caller and writer of pr_commits and GitLandingRecords, including run.rs retry_landing, drain.rs and reconcile.rs. Each must come with the test that covers it and the command that was run. The event does not say what the first reading wrote. Judging by the correction, it did not carry the verifier's criterion-7 finding into the reading as a required item, or it did not name the callers and the per-caller evidence.
cause: The reading for a retry is built from the request text. The earlier verifier's findings, here the single unmet criterion, are not carried into it as required items. The reading stage also has no step that lists the callers of a changed interface, or the evidence that a change description must hold for each one. So the end state the earlier stage had already found was left out, and the user had to restate it. This is the same gap as in the earlier cases on this job family.
prevention: When a request is a retry or follow-up, the reading stage should start from the earlier job's verifier verdict. Every unmet criterion and finding should become a required item in the new reading, stated in full. The reading should be checked against that list before it is accepted. For changes to a shared interface, the reading should also list every caller found by searching the repo, and require the change description to name each one with its covering test and the command run.
proposed_request: Retry job 20261024-170227-4scc. The earlier attempt's code passed every check, and only acceptance criterion 7 failed. Keep the code as it is. Fix the change description only. The commit message body and the CHANGELOG entry must list every caller and writer of pr_commits and GitLandingRecords, including run.rs retry_landing, drain.rs and reconcile.rs. Search the repo to confirm the list is complete. For each one, name the test that covers it and the exact command that was run, such as cargo test -p athena-core reconcile::. Run those commands and report the results. Do not use words banned by the boundary test in the text. Make no code or test changes unless a listed caller turns out to have no covering test. In that case, add the smallest test for it.
